What Soft-Close Hinge Upgrade Involves

We upgrade spring-loaded or standard hinges to modern soft-close damped hinges, eliminating door slamming and giving your kitchen a noticeably more premium feel. Soft-close hinges are a direct drop-in replacement for standard 35mm concealed hinges and work with all major cabinet carcass brands.

Common Reasons Customers Book This Service

  • Standard hinges slamming in a household with young children
  • Old spring hinges losing tension and doors falling open
  • Noise reduction required in open-plan kitchen-diner
  • Premium finish desired as part of kitchen refresh

Typical time on site: Half a day for a full kitchen.

Pricing for Soft-Close Hinge Upgrade in Coventry

Our soft-close hinge upgrade service in Coventry starts from £40. The final price depends on the scope of work — number of units affected, whether replacement parts are required, and access within the property.

We always confirm the price before any work begins. For straightforward jobs where the scope is clear from the initial description, we will provide a fixed quote when you get in touch. For more complex situations where we need to assess on site first, we will quote a maximum price at the beginning of the visit and will not exceed it without your explicit agreement.

Kitchen Repairs in Coventry

Coventry has a hugely varied housing stock from Victorian terraces in Earlsdon and Chapelfields to post-war semis across Tile Hill and Canley, with newer executive builds around Finham and Stivichall.

Kitchens in Coventry's Victorian and Edwardian properties often have uneven floors and out-of-plumb walls requiring careful levelling and scribing.

Coventry's wide range of property ages means our fitters regularly adapt installations to suit everything from narrow Victorian galley kitchens to open-plan ground floors in modern new builds.

At the same visit we can also upgrade your drawer runners to full-extension soft-close runners, completing the premium feel across the whole kitchen.

Frequently Asked Questions

In almost all cases yes — modern soft-close hinges use the same 35mm cup hole as standard concealed hinges, making them a direct swap. The only exception is if your cabinets use a non-standard hinge system, which is rare. We will confirm compatibility with your kitchen brand before the visit.

Upgrading a full kitchen of 15–20 doors typically takes half a day. We replace every hinge and carry out a full alignment check and adjustment on each door as part of the same visit, so every door is hanging perfectly when we finish.

Yes — if you would like to source your own hinges to save cost, we are happy to fit them. We recommend Blum Clip Top Blumotion or Hettich Intermat hinges as reliable, long-lasting options available from Screwfix or Toolstation. Please confirm the overlay dimension (full, half, or inset) before purchasing.

Most customers tell us the difference is immediately noticeable and that they wished they had done it sooner. Beyond the noise reduction, soft-close hinges also extend the life of the door and cabinet face frame by eliminating the repeated impact of slamming. For a kitchen you use every day, the upgrade is very cost-effective.
